control_seed.$comment: one seed for every part of a suite, drawn once and recorded (RFC-0008 §Seeds)

host.$comment: the host this part ran on; parts of one suite need not share it (RFC-0008 SPLIT-4)

machine.$comment: the RFC-0006 machine record of this host, its allowlisted fields only

nonconforming.$comment: one line per profile check this host does not meet; recorded, not refused

only.$comment: the controls this part ran, in suite order

profile.$comment: the run's profile, on whose hosts prover-side controls prove

run_manifest_digest.$comment: sha256 of the run's manifest.json bytes: every part ran against the same run

seed_record_digest.$comment: sha256 of the run's controls-seed.json bytes, the record the seed came from (RFC-0008 SPLIT-1)

suite.$comment: every control of the suite, in the order controls.json lists them

verifier_cpus.$comment: a count of the CPUs this part's verify calls were bound to, not a measurement

title: One part of a control suite run split across hosts, merged into controls.json by iproofs controls --merge (RFC-0008 §Split suites)
